optimizedDescription.value: Backend-neutral GraphStore contract: atomic durable graph persistence, deterministic indexed reads/search, freshness, recovery, bulk indexing.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules

- `GraphStore`: abstract `domain/ports/` class; constructor `storagePath`; `infrastructure/` adapters own schema, layout, backend. Consumers use abstract semantics.
- Persist `FileNode` (canonical/config-relative paths, full `content`), `SymbolNode`, `SpecNode`, `DocumentNode`, metadata (`lastIndexedAt`, `lastIndexedRef`, `graphFingerprint`), relations `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; `COVERS_SYMBOL.metadata.stale` allowed.
- Lifecycle: `open()` prepares only; never clears/recreates. `close()` idempotent. Unopened operation throws `StoreNotOpenError`. Typed recoverable open errors retain other error identities.
- `recreate()` requires closed store; destructively replaces persistence, rotates generation, leaves closed. `clear()` requires open healthy store; removes every logical artifact influencing indexing/query, preserves physical schema/generation. Provider/SDK authorizes recovery; host never manipulates backend files.
- Persist generation marker; provider caches at `open()` then detects external destructive replacement before reads.
- `upsertFile(file, symbols, relations)`: atomic replacement file, its symbols, relations; failure preserves prior state. `addRelations(relations)` additive only. `removeFile(filePath)` atomic file, symbols, incident relations removal. Compare `contentHash` before update.
- `upsertSpec(spec, relations)` atomically replaces node/outgoing `DEPENDS_ON`; `removeSpec(specId)` removes node/incident `DEPENDS_ON`. Upsert/remove/search documents.
- Single reads: `getFile`, `findFilesByConfigRelativePath`, `getSymbol`, `getSpec`; callers/callees; importers/importees; extend/implement/override both directions; spec deps/dependents; file/symbol coverage both directions; `findSymbols(SymbolQuery)`. `SymbolQuery`: name glob/regex, `kinds`, `filePath`, `comment`, default `caseSensitive=false`.
- Batch traversal: `getSymbolsByIds`, `getIncomingSymbolRelations`, `getOutgoingSymbolRelations`; support `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Deduplicate; omit absent; empty => no backend work; deterministic symbols request order, relations source/type/target; no per-symbol/type store calls.
- Exact batches `getFilesByPaths`, `getDocumentsByPaths`, `getSpecsByIds`: deduplicate preserving first requested order, omit absent, empty no work, no per-identity call. Keep single/complete APIs; never use batch reads for display-path derivation.
- `getStatistics()` returns file/symbol/spec counts, relation counts, languages, `lastIndexedAt`, `lastIndexedRef`, `graphFingerprint`. `clear()`, `getAllFiles()`, `getAllSpecs()` support reindex/diff.
- Search: `searchSymbols`, `searchSpecs`, `searchDocuments`, `rebuildFtsIndexes`; snippets with 1-based ranges. Ranking: exact canonical identity > exact name/alternate identity > prefix/suffix/component/substring identity > generic BM25/content. Filters precede `limit`; generic retrieval remains.
- Shared lexical expansion: normalized original plus whitespace, `:`, `/`, `_`, `.`, `-`, CamelCase/PascalCase splits; strength exact > prefix > suffix > substring; component match outranks arbitrary substring; greater token coverage ranks higher. `SearchOptions`: `query`, `limit=20`, `kind`, `filePattern`, `workspace`, `excludePaths`, `excludeWorkspaces`.
- Persist logical symbols, declarations, spaces, member forms, public/local bindings, provenance, coverage; distinct routes/bindings remain distinct. Indexed lookup by workspace/surface/name/space/owner/member/declaration/export/local scope/coverage; never parse, case-fold, substring-search canonical IDs for semantic resolution/ranking.
- Expose deterministic full reference-fact snapshot, direct affected-file batch over import/call/construct/type-use/extend/implement/override, reverse coverage batch. No complete scans/per-reference calls; coverage order source/type/target.
- `COVERS_SYMBOL` targets current logical symbol ID, never declaration occurrence ID. Validate spec/logical-symbol endpoints in committed generation.
- Source-content candidates use persisted `FileNode.content`, full construct/selection ranges, normalized/raw/expanded query, category limit, filters/exclusions/snippet preference; return file, backend relevance, evidence enough for app verification. Substring index >=3 chars; bounded short-query fallback; never return/scan all files. Store supplies candidates; app merges/provenance/suppression/ranking/grouping/final limits.
- Incompatible schema rejects reads; indexing repair destructively rebuilds, rotates generation, rebuilds indexes; no incremental migration required.
- Persist `IndexedInputObservation`: workspace/resource kind/id/input kind/logical locator/content hash/optional mtime-size-revision/monotonic stale. Batch/CAS stale marking, equal-content refresh, workspace/global latches atomic; only successful indexing clears stale/latches; transient unknown never persists stale.
- One bulk session: begin once; bounded file/document/spec/symbol/semantic-fact/observation/relation chunks; commit once; rebuild semantic/source indexes once. Batch endpoint/hierarchy/method lookup; deduplicate cross-chunk relations; failure exposes no partial generation.

## Constraints

- Backend-neutral; `GraphStore` abstract class, not interface; no `@specd/core`; errors extend `CodeGraphError`.
- File-level mutations atomic; batch results deterministic; physical chunking allowed only when transparent.
- Backend/layout unspecified; host never deletes backend files or directly resets storage.
